'''Viti''' (Biti) or '''Vötö''' (Bötö), also known as '''Nde-Gbite''', is a [[Narrow Grassfields language]] of [[Nigeria]], spoken in the village of Antere in [[Taraba State]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.ethnologue.com/language/vit|title=Viti|work=Ethnologue|access-date=2017-08-12}}</ref> half a kilometre from the [[Cameroon|Cameroonian]] border. It is not clear how close or distinct it is from other [[Grassfields languages|Grassfields]] varieties.
